slate_summary: The 2026 WNBA playoff slate offers four high-stakes matchups with mixed data quality. Indiana vs. Las Vegas features elite volume from A'ja Wilson and strong consistency from supporting cast (Olivia Miles, Kelsey Mitchell). New York vs. Minnesota benefits from Paige Bueckers' recent hot stretch. Atlanta vs. Washington highlights Angel Reese's remarkable rebounding consistency. Overall, player prop evidence is stronger than game-level lines, driven by recent playoff-form acceleration and elevated usage in elimination settings. Several over-under and spread lines lack sufficient differentiation from season norms to justify strong conviction. Market pricing on elite scorers is mostly fair; value exists in role-player consistency plays and assist-based props where recent volume increases support the lines.
